verses.1: Oh land, whose branches stretch across the rivers of Kush!
verses.2: Those who are sent into the sea become weak and helpless. They go to a land that is full of dangers and hardships. It’s a land where people are cruel and harsh. There are also rivers in this land.
verses.3: All those who dwell in Egypt and the inhabitants of the land shall see what happens when the mountains are shaken. They shall hear the sound of the trumpet.
verses.4: For as Jehovah said, “I will make them suffer and be destroyed in my hand, like dry dust under the light of the sun, like chaff in the heat of summer.”
verses.5: Before the harvest, there will be a time when the flowers wither and die. Then, the weeds will be removed from the fields.
verses.6: They will be left alone, to die in the mountains and on the land. All the animals on that land will also die.
verses.7: On that day, Jehovah’s army will come with a mighty and numerous force. They will be a people who are from among His people. A great multitude will gather there; rivers will flow from their land to the place where Jehovah’s army will be stationed on Mount Zion.
